questions.text: Two eigen values of a 3x3 real matrix P are (2+[latex]\sqrt{-1}[/latex]) and 3.The determinantof P is __________.
questions.solution:
A real matrix has complex eigenvalues in conjugate pairs, so [latex]2-i[/latex] is the third eigenvalue.

[latex]\det P=(2+i)(2-i)\times3=(4+1)\times3=15[/latex]

Answer: 15

questions.text: If for non-zero  [latex]x,af(x)+bf\left ( \frac{1}{x} \right )=\frac{1}{x}-25[/latex] where [latex] a\neq b[/latex]  then [latex] \int_{1}^{2}f(x)dx[/latex] is
questions.solution:
Replace x by 1/x: [latex]af(1/x)+bf(x)=x-25[/latex]. Eliminate f(1/x):

[latex](a^2-b^2)f(x)=\frac ax-25a-bx+25b[/latex]

Integrate from 1 to 2: [latex]a\ln2-25a-\frac{3b}{2}+25b=a(\ln2-25)+\frac{47b}{2}[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\frac{1}{a^2-b^2}[a(\ln2-25)+\frac{47b}{2}][/latex]

questions.text:
If the following system has non-trivial solution,
px+qy+rz=0
qx+ry+pz=0
rx+py+qz=0,
then which one of the following options is TRUE?
questions.solution:
Non-trivial solution needs determinant = 0:

[latex]\begin{vmatrix}p&q&r\\q&r&p\\r&p&q\end{vmatrix}=-(p+q+r)(p^2+q^2+r^2-pq-qr-rp)=0[/latex]

The second factor is [latex]\frac12[(p-q)^2+(q-r)^2+(r-p)^2][/latex], zero only when p = q = r.

Answer: p + q + r = 0 or p = q = r

questions.text:
The velocity v (in kilometer/minute) of a motorbike which starts from rest, is given at fixed intervals of time t (in minutes) as follows:

The approximate distance (in kilometers) rounded to two places of decimals covered in 20 minutes using Simpson's [latex]1/3^{rd}[/latex] rule is _______________.
questions.solution:
The bike starts from rest, so v = 0 at t = 0. With h = 2 we have 11 points:
v = 0, 10, 18, 25, 29, 32, 20, 11, 5, 2, 0

- Odd positions: 10 + 25 + 32 + 11 + 2 = 80
- Even (inner) positions: 18 + 29 + 20 + 5 = 72

[latex]D=\frac{h}{3}[v_0+v_{10}+4(80)+2(72)]=\frac23(0+0+320+144)=309.33[/latex]

Answer: 309.33
